title: Osaka: flea market, Shinsekai, Dōtonbori, castle by night
summary: The Shitennō-ji flea market first thing, kushikatsu in Shinsekai, Namba snacks and KOMEHYO, Umeda Sky at sunset, then Dōtonbori, okonomiyaki and the castle lit up.

rows.what: To Kyoto Station, then JR to Tennōji
rows.detail: One subway stop or 15 minutes on foot. JR special rapid to Osaka, about 30 minutes, then the Osaka Loop line to Tennōji, about 20 minutes. Suica covers it all.
On the 21st and 22nd of every month, from 08:30. Kimono and yukata, pottery, vintage toys and records, masks, food stalls. Breakfast from the stalls. Free. Cash and a tote bag.
About 15 minutes on foot west of the temple. The retro neon district under the tower.

Walk Janjan-Yokochō away from Tsūtenkaku to the end of the covered lane: the Dōbutsuen-mae stairs (red M, 動物園前) are at the junction. Buy the Enjoy Eco Card, about ¥820, then two stops towards Umeda to Namba.

rows.what: Rikuro cheesecake and 551 Hōrai pork buns
rows.detail: The jiggly cheesecake: take the freshly baked line for a warm one. 551 Hōrai's pork buns are a minute away. Suitcase: Bic Camera Namba is close by for a quick look, buy later.
The giant lion head. About 10 minutes on foot west of Namba. Ten minutes there is enough. Closes about 17:00.

rows.what: Free time: the Dōtonbori bucket list
rows.detail: Any order. 1. The Glico Running Man from Ebisu Bridge. 2. Don Quijote ferris wheel, Ebisu Tower: ¥1,000, about 15 minutes, best after dark. 3. Tombori River Cruise, about 20 minutes, once it is dark. 4. Okonomiyaki dinner at Mizuno, the best in Osaka, open to 22:00. 5. Takoyaki at Kukuru under the giant octopus. 6. The big signs: the moving Kani Dōraku crab and the Kuidaore Tarō drummer. 7. Hōzenji Yokochō and the mossy Mizukake Fudō. 8. KOMEHYO, to 20:00. 9. Amerikamura and Kōgaryū takoyaki. 10. A cheap suitcase at Don Quijote. Taxi to the castle about 19:30. Done: all except the Tombori River Cruise.

About 15 to 20 minutes, about ¥1,800. Ask for Ōsaka-jō, Ōtemon (大阪城 大手門). Then about 10 minutes on foot to the keep. Note: the first taxi went to Tsūtenkaku (the Hitachi tower) by mistake. Second taxi from Shinsekai about 20:15.
Free projection mapping on the south face of the keep. About six minutes, repeating until 22:00. Standing only. Watch one or two rounds.
From the castle out to Temmabashi station.

1. Keihan Temmabashi (京阪 天満橋), platform for 京都・出町柳 (Kyoto, Demachiyanagi). 2. Take the 特急 (limited express), about 45 minutes, to 七条 (Shichijō). 3. Taxi about 5 minutes, about ¥800, or walk 18 minutes west along Shichijō then up Karasuma. All on Suica.

notes: The morning castle walk, Daruma kushikatsu, Kuromon Market, the Horie browsing, the Tombori cruise, Hōzenji Yokochō and Umeda Sky.
